title: Hello World + AI Chat
summary: Built a Flask web app with multiple pages and an AI chat experience, connecting a browser interface to a Python backend and an AI API.
learned: Routes, Jinja templates, HTML forms, API requests, environment variables, and AI-assisted implementation.
coolest: Turning a basic website into an interactive chat product with a working end-to-end request flow.

title: Financial Future Dashboard
summary: Built an interactive personal-finance dashboard for budgeting and long-term investing scenarios, including a comparison of starting to invest at age 18 versus age 28.
learned: JSON data, Flask-to-template data flow, form handling, financial calculations, and interactive data visualization.
coolest: Visualizing how a ten-year head start can dramatically change long-term compound growth.

title: MCP Agent Workflow
summary: Built a small agent-tool workflow that routes user requests to specialized tools and incorporates tool results into a final response.
learned: Tool schemas, MCP-style tool exposure, routing logic, structured outputs, and how agent systems combine reasoning with external functions.
coolest: Watching the workflow choose a tool based on the request instead of responding as a plain chatbot.

title: AI Study Buddy with RAG
summary: Built a study assistant that processes documents, breaks them into searchable chunks, retrieves relevant context, and uses that context to answer questions.
learned: Document extraction, chunking, embeddings, cosine similarity, retrieval-augmented generation, persistence, and multimodal AI workflows.
coolest: Seeing a question retrieve the most relevant passages from an uploaded document before generating an answer.

title: AI Games: Tic-Tac-Toe & Hangman
summary: Built AI-enhanced browser games with game-state management, computer moves, coaching hints, commentary, score tracking, and safe fallbacks when an AI call is unavailable.
learned: Flask sessions, game logic, JSON persistence, structured AI output, validation, and resilient fallback behavior.
coolest: Making the AI part of the game experience through opponent behavior, hints, recaps, and generated commentary.
